create_DAC_model: create a DAC VAE model from a DacVAEConfig with encoder, decoder, and quantizer components
encode_audio_waveform: encode audio waveform tensor into quantized latent codes using the DAC encoder
decode_latent_codes: decode quantized latent representations back to reconstructed audio waveform
apply_quantizer_dropout: apply quantizer dropout by randomly dropping codebooks during training in VQ mode
reconstruct_from_codes: reconstruct audio latents from discrete codebook indices using ResidualVectorQuantize.from_codes
